# Playbooks: Help, knowledge and agent instructions (`lpm-knowledge`)

Load a section only when `lpm-knowledge.md` tells you to.

## § flow-delete

## Flow: delete a knowledge item, article or file record
Load when: decision row 7

### Preconditions
1. An LPM API key with a `full` or `custom` profile; file records need project manage rights.
2. itemId, fileId: step 1 (the SKILL.md §3 article list hides draft, deprecated and hidden articles). baselineIds: `list_requirement_baselines`(projectId) → every `id`.

### Steps
1. Resolve the id and keep `name`, kind and, for an article, `slug`. kind = document (from `list_project_knowledge_items`), article or file record; never show the raw `kind` field value ("asset"). Document: `list_project_knowledge_items`(projectId). Article: `list_help_articles`(projectId, agentVisibleOnly=false, limitCount=100) once per status (`draft`, `published`, `deprecated`). File: `list_project_files`(projectId). All pages each; 0 or 2+ name matches → Stop and ask row 2.
2. Document only: `list_requirement_baselines`(projectId) → for EVERY baseline `id` (isCurrent true AND false; list each `list_requirements` call you make): `list_requirements`(projectId, baselineId) → a `sourceDocumentId == itemId` → STOP: Stop and ask row 1. End the turn. Report Done: nothing deleted; Pending: your decision on deleting <id>. A yes to row 1 is not the step-3 confirmation: still show step 3 and wait for a second "yes". A result with `truncated: true` → Stop and ask row 3. No baseline → say "no baseline to check".
3. [C] Show "Delete <name> (<kind>, id <id>)? No undo; the stored file stays." Document: add "Requirements not yet in a baseline cannot be checked." Article: add "No MCP tool can recreate it." Wait for "yes".
4. `delete_knowledge_item`(projectId, itemId) [C] or `delete_project_file`(projectId, fileId) [C] (these two tools take no idempotencyKey; send only projectId and itemId/fileId). "not found" → re-list; no retry.
5. Verify: run § Verify (call the tool again; never reuse the step 1 list).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| a requirement uses the document | "Requirement <id> (baseline <baseline name>) uses <name> as its source; deleting breaks that link. Delete anyway?" |
| 0 or 2+ entries match the name | "Which one: <id> <name> or <id> <name>?" |
| `list_requirements` returned `truncated: true` | "Baseline <baseline name> is too large to check completely; a requirement may still use <name>. Delete anyway?" |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| document delete | call `list_project_knowledge_items`(projectId) again, all pages | the id is absent |
| article delete | `get_help_article`(projectId, slug, publishedOnly=false, agentVisibleOnly=false) | the error is "Help article not found" |
| file record delete | call `list_project_files`(projectId) again, all pages | the id is absent |

### Report fields
Scope (project), kind, name and id deleted, the user's "yes" quoted, Pending, Next.


## § flow-register

## Flow: register a document or file record
Load when: decision row 5

### Preconditions
1. An LPM API key. Document: profile `full`, `requirements` or `custom`. File record: profile `full`, `portfolio` or `custom`, and project manage rights.
2. Only a link to a file that is already stored: no URL → SKILL.md §6 row 2.

### Steps
1. Classify with see `lpm-knowledge.refs.md` § artifact-store-map: evidence of work → SKILL.md §6 row 1; reusable reference document → document; entry for the project's file list → file record.
2. Document: `list_project_knowledge_items`(projectId); file record: `list_project_files`(projectId). All pages (loop `nextCursor` while `hasMore`) → same name or URL → STOP: "already registered as <id>".
3. Document `fileType` from the file extension: `.pdf` → `pdf`; `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp` → `image`; `.txt`, `.md` → `text`; any other → ask. File record `type` (MIME) and `size` (bytes) come from the user. Name, type or size unknown → SKILL.md §6 row 4; never guess.
4. Document: `create_knowledge_item`(projectId, name, fileUrl, fileType, fileName) [A] → keep the id after "ID: ".
5. File record: `create_project_file`(projectId, name, url, type=<MIME>, size=<bytes>) [A] → keep the id after "ID: ".
6. Timeout → run step 2 again before any resend (both creates are not idempotent).
7. Verify: run § Verify.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| same name or URL already listed | "Already registered as <id> (<name>). Register another one anyway?" |
| extension not in step 3 | "Is this file a PDF, an image or a text file?" |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| document create | call `list_project_knowledge_items`(projectId) again, all pages (never reuse the step 2 list) | the kept id is present |
| file record create | call `list_project_files`(projectId) again, all pages (never reuse the step 2 list) | the kept id is present |

### Report fields
Scope (project), kind (document or file record), name and id created, Pending, Next.


## § flow-roadmap-note

## Flow: roadmap knowledge note
Load when: decision rows 9 and 10

### Preconditions
1. All four note tools need an LPM API key (not on connectors).
2. Accept and reject need the workspace owner or an admin and the owner's decision in this conversation (SKILL.md §6 row 3).
3. Field values and defaults: see `lpm-knowledge.refs.md` § roadmap-knowledge.
4. Scope: an item named → `list_workspace_roadmap_items`(workspaceId, compact=true) → match `title` → `id` (itemId); a roadmap named → `list_workspace_roadmaps`(workspaceId) → match `title` → `id` (roadmapId); neither → whole workspace. 0 or 2+ matches → ask.
5. artifactId: `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="draft") → `id`; none → "no draft note". Note target projectId: `list_workspace_projects`(workspaceId) → `id`.
6. Article key: `<prefix>` = the first 8 characters of artifactId, lowercased. The accepted article's slug ends with "-<prefix>" unless the title is longer than 55 characters (the slug is cut at 64).

### Steps
Draft (row 9):
1. `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="draft", itemId for an item, roadmapId for a roadmap, no scope filter for the workspace) → keep only the same scope: item → `itemId == itemId`; roadmap → `itemId == null`; workspace → `roadmapId == null` and `itemId == null`. Any left → Stop and ask row 1.
2. Preview (no AI spent): `analyze_workspace_roadmap_item`(workspaceId, itemId) or `analyze_workspace_roadmap`(workspaceId, roadmapId).
3. `draft_roadmap_knowledge`(workspaceId, itemId or roadmapId, projectId, title) [A] → keep `id`, `summary`, `content`. No projectId → LPM uses the first grounding project: say so. Timeout → step 1 before any retry (each call creates a draft).
4. Show `summary` and `content`: "Not project knowledge until the owner accepts it."
5. Verify: run § Verify (call the list again; never reuse the step 1 list).

Accept or reject (row 10):
6. `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="draft") → artifactId not listed → STOP: "the note is no longer a draft". Keep its `title` and `projectId`.
7. Accept values: projectId = the note's `projectId` from step 6 unless the owner named another project; `status` = the owner's choice between `draft` (default) and `published`; `guidanceLevel="informational"` unless the owner named one (`guardrail`/`forbidden` only on order).
8. [C] Show the exact call and, for `draft`: "Saved as a draft article; agents will not read it until someone publishes it in the LPM web app"; for `published`: "agents will read this article". Wait for the owner's "yes".
9. `accept_roadmap_knowledge_artifact`(workspaceId, artifactId, projectId, status, guidanceLevel, confirmed=true) [C], or `reject_roadmap_knowledge_artifact`(workspaceId, artifactId, reason=<owner's words>, confirmed=true) [C].
10. Accept timed out → never resend first: `search_help_articles`(projectId, query=<prefix>, status=<status sent>, agentVisibleOnly=false) → an item whose `slug` ends with "-<prefix>" (0 items → once more with query=<note title>, match `name`). Then step 6 again: note `accepted` → step 11; article found and note still a draft → Stop and ask row 4; neither → resend step 9 once.
11. Verify: run § Verify.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| a draft already exists for the scope | "Draft <id> exists. Use it, or create a new one?" |
| no owner decision for accept or reject | SKILL.md §6 row 3; STOP |
| `access_denied` on accept or reject | "Only the workspace owner or an admin can decide notes." STOP |
| article found after a timeout, note still a draft | STOP. Pending: "article <id> was created but note <artifactId> is still a draft; do not accept again; the owner decides (reject the note, or keep the article)" |
| "Only draft roadmap knowledge artifacts can be accepted." | already decided: read `acceptedKnowledgeItemId`; no retry |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| draft | call `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="draft") again | the draft `id` is listed |
| reject | `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="rejected") (never filter by projectId) | an item `id == artifactId` |
| accept | `list_roadmap_knowledge_artifacts`(workspaceId, status="accepted") (never filter by projectId); `search_help_articles`(projectId, query=<prefix>, status=<status sent>, agentVisibleOnly=false), all pages (0 items → query=<note title>) | an item `id == artifactId` with `acceptedKnowledgeItemId`; an article item `id == acceptedKnowledgeItemId` |

### Report fields
Scope (workspace, project, roadmapId or itemId), note artifactId and state (draft, accepted, rejected), acceptedKnowledgeItemId, the owner's instruction quoted, Pending (accepted as `draft` → "publish article <id> in the web app"), Next.


## § flow-skills-context

## Flow: skills context write
Load when: decision row 8

### Preconditions
1. An LPM API key with a `full` or `custom` profile (create, update and delete) and project manage rights.
2. Field semantics and rules: see `lpm-knowledge.refs.md` § skills-contexts.
3. skillsContextId: `list_skills_contexts`(projectId) → `id` with `status == "active"`; 0 or 2+ → ask.

### Steps
1. `list_skills_contexts`(projectId) → an active context for the same purpose → update it, never create a second.
2. `get_skills_context`(projectId, skillsContextId) → keep every field's current text.
3. Build the change (see `lpm-knowledge.refs.md` § skills-contexts): only changed fields, each with its complete new text; `""` clears; no `defaultModel` unless the owner named it; no secret.
4. [C] Show the call with before → after per field (`isDefault=true` unsets the other default); wait for "yes".
5. `create_skills_context`(projectId, name, instructions, <optional fields>) [C] (timeout → step 1 for the `name` before any retry), or `update_skills_context`(projectId, skillsContextId, <fields> or status="archived") [C].
6. Only on "delete" (else archive): show the step 2 text that will be lost, then `delete_skills_context`(projectId, skillsContextId) [C].
7. Verify: run § Verify (call the tools again; never reuse the step 1 list).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| `defaultModel` without the owner's order | SKILL.md §6 row 3; STOP |
| 2+ active contexts for the same purpose | "Which context: <id> <name> or <id> <name>?" |
| "You do not have permission to manage this project" | "A project manager must run this change." STOP |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| create, update, archive | `get_skills_context`(projectId, skillsContextId) | each sent field equals its new value after trimming; a `""` sent for an optional field reads `null` |
| `isDefault=true` sent | call `list_skills_contexts`(projectId) again | exactly one context has `isDefault == true`: this one |
| delete | call `list_skills_contexts`(projectId) again | the id is absent |

### Report fields
Scope (project, skillsContextId), fields before → after, the user's "yes" quoted, Pending, Next.
